summary: Ship the encodeGrantAuditEvent/encodeAssignmentAuditEvent encoder (pure function, the contractual seam T-0030 calls at every grant write call-site) that maps GrantAuditEvent→AuditEventInput for the T-0016 audit floor, plus the grant-trail read API (GET /api/grant-trail, filterable by role/actor/subject) and UI wiring of GrantTrailScreen to the live endpoint, so every grant create/revoke/assignment change is permanently queryable as a first-class row in the unified per-tenant audit_event table.
functional: FR-1 encodeGrantAuditEvent(e: GrantAuditEvent, nowMs: number): AuditEventInput — pure IO-free encoder exported from src/core/audit-grant-encoder.ts; maps kind→type, actor, subjectRoleId→subject, scope, proposedBy→proposed_by, confirmedBy→confirmed_by, capability→payload, nowMs→occurred_at; does NOT set chain columns (seq/prev_hash/row_hash/vocab_version).

FR-2 encodeAssignmentAuditEvent(e: AssignmentAuditEvent, nowMs: number): AuditEventInput — pure encoder for assignment.create/assignment.revoke events; maps actor, employeeId→subject, orgScope→scope, roleId→payload.roleId, proposedBy/confirmedBy, nowMs→occurred_at.

FR-3 queryGrantTrail(db, tenantId, opts): Promise<GrantTrailRow[]> — DB query function exported from src/db/audit-grant-trail.ts that reads audit_event rows where type IN ('grant.create','grant.revoke','assignment.create','assignment.revoke') inside withTenant (RLS-scoped); supports roleId/actor/subject/limit/beforeSeq filter options.

FR-4 GET /api/grant-trail — HTTP endpoint registered in src/http/grant-trail.ts; query params: role_id, actor, subject, limit (default 100, max 500), before_seq; returns {rows: GrantTrailRow[], hasMore: boolean}; static seed fallback when DATABASE_URL absent.

FR-5 GrantTrailScreen UI wiring — web/src/screens/rights/ra-grant-trail.jsx fetches GET /api/grant-trail on mount, renders live rows; TRAIL constant from ra-data.jsx becomes fallback/initial state only.

FR-6 Encoder is the contractual seam for T-0030: T-0030's coder imports encodeGrantAuditEvent and encodeAssignmentAuditEvent from src/core/audit-grant-encoder.ts and calls them before appendAuditEvent at every grant/assignment write call-site; this is additive for T-0030 (no change to the encoder's implementation).
non_functional: NF-1 Encoder is pure and IO-free: src/core/audit-grant-encoder.ts contains no pg/fetch/http/net/child_process import; static lint asserts this; equal inputs => equal output.
NF-2 Encoder does not redefine GrantAuditEvent: imports it verbatim from grant-lattice.ts; grant-lattice.ts is not edited by T-0031.
NF-3 No new tenant table: grant trail data lives entirely in audit_event; known_tenant_tables.txt unchanged; any seed migration is INSERT-only into audit_event numbered 030+.
NF-4 Trail query is RLS-scoped: queryGrantTrail always runs inside withTenant (sets choros.tenant_id GUC); cross-tenant leakage is prevented by the existing audit_event RLS policy.

NF-5 Chain compatibility: encoder output fields match audit_event column set exactly; payload is a plain JSON-serializable object; occurred_at is epoch-ms as TS number; no chain columns in the returned AuditEventInput.
NF-6 No edit to audit_event DDL: T-0031 adds no columns and ships no DDL migrations for audit_event or audit_head.
NF-7 Backward-compatible static fallback: GET /api/grant-trail returns seed data when DATABASE_URL is not set, preserving current dev-no-Postgres UI behavior.
NF-8 HTTP error codes machine-readable: limit>500 or non-integer limit/before_seq => 400 INVALID_PARAM.
out_of_scope: appendAuditEvent live DB implementation = T-0053 (Postgres-in-compose); T-0031 delivers the encoder that produces AuditEventInput; the live append path is T-0053.
T-0030 HTTP write-call-sites: T-0030's coder adds the import+call to encodeGrantAuditEvent at its write call-sites; T-0031 only delivers the encoder and its contract.
assignment.narrow event type: the UI seed has action='narrow'; day-1 scope is grant.create/grant.revoke/assignment.create/assignment.revoke only; narrow is a future event type.
role_criticality (crit) flag pre-computation on trail rows = T-0040/T-0044; UI recomputes client-side.
Server-side filter by action type (grant/revoke/narrow tabs): day-1 client-side filter; server-side type filter is deferred.
Dual-control gate confirmation audit events = T-0044 (E4.6).
LLM-proposes grant workflow audit = T-0039 (E3.5); encoder already threads proposed_by/confirmed_by.
Keycloak/JWT auth in the trail endpoint = T-0054.

acceptance_criteria.text: encodeGrantAuditEvent({ kind:'grant.create', actor:'u1', subjectRoleId:'role-x', capability:{resourceType:'record',operation:'read'}, scope:{kind:'node',hierarchy:'org',nodeId:'dept-1',nodeLevel:'department'} }, 1000) returns AuditEventInput with type='grant.create', actor='u1', subject='role-x', scope equal to the supplied ScopeElement, proposed_by=null, confirmed_by=null, payload.resourceType='record', payload.operation='read', occurred_at=1000.
encodeGrantAuditEvent with proposedBy='llm' and confirmedBy='u2' returns proposed_by='llm' and confirmed_by='u2'.
encodeGrantAuditEvent with kind='grant.revoke' returns type='grant.revoke'.
encodeGrantAuditEvent with capability.resourceFacet present includes resourceFacet in payload; absent resourceFacet produces no resourceFacet key in payload.

encodeAssignmentAuditEvent({ kind:'assignment.create', actor:'u1', employeeId:'emp-1', roleId:'role-x', orgScope:{kind:'node',hierarchy:'org',nodeId:'dept-1',nodeLevel:'department'} }, 2000) returns type='assignment.create', actor='u1', subject='emp-1', scope equal to orgScope, payload.roleId='role-x', occurred_at=2000.
encodeAssignmentAuditEvent with kind='assignment.revoke' returns type='assignment.revoke'.
Encoder output for both encodeGrantAuditEvent and encodeAssignmentAuditEvent contains no chain columns (seq, prev_hash, row_hash, vocab_version) — those fields are absent from the returned object.
encodeGrantAuditEvent is pure: called twice with the same arguments (including explicit id override) returns structurally equal objects for all fields including id.
Static lint: src/core/audit-grant-encoder.ts imports GrantAuditEvent and Scope from grant-lattice.ts and contains no pg, fetch, http, https, net, or child_process import.
Static lint: src/core/grant-lattice.ts exports the GrantAuditEvent type unchanged from its current definition — T-0031 adds no new exports to and makes no edits to grant-lattice.ts.

Static lint: unit tests for audit-grant-encoder demonstrate the T-0030 call contract — at minimum one test shows: const input = encodeGrantAuditEvent(event, nowMs); followed by a mocked appendAuditEvent(tx, input) call — validating the seam is callable from T-0030 without further changes to the encoder.

GET /api/grant-trail (no filters) returns HTTP 200 with JSON body { rows: [...], hasMore: boolean } where each row contains seq, id, type, actor, subject, scope, proposed_by, confirmed_by, payload, occurred_at.
GET /api/grant-trail?role_id=<id> returns only rows where subject=<id> (grant events) or payload.roleId=<id> (assignment events).
GET /api/grant-trail?actor=<id> returns only rows where actor=<id>.
GET /api/grant-trail?limit=5 returns at most 5 rows; hasMore=true when more rows are available.
GET /api/grant-trail?limit=600 returns HTTP 400 INVALID_PARAM.
GET /api/grant-trail?before_seq=abc (non-integer) returns HTTP 400 INVALID_PARAM.
GET /api/grant-trail when DATABASE_URL is not set returns HTTP 200 with static seed data (fallback, >= 1 row).

queryGrantTrail runs inside withTenant (uses choros.tenant_id GUC). Cross-tenant: rows inserted for tenant A are not returned when queried as tenant B (covered by existing cross_tenant.test.ts via known_tenant_tables.txt audit_event entry).

queryGrantTrail returns only rows where type IN ('grant.create','grant.revoke','assignment.create','assignment.revoke'). A row with type='approve' inserted into audit_event is NOT returned by queryGrantTrail.

GrantTrailScreen mounts, calls fetch('/api/grant-trail'), and renders the response rows in the trail table (>= 1 .chs-trailrow element after fetch resolves); the static TRAIL constant is no longer the primary data source.
No new tenant table is created by T-0031. known_tenant_tables.txt is unchanged. Fitness lint asserts no new CREATE TABLE in any migration numbered 030+ shipped by T-0031.
If T-0031 ships a seed migration (INSERT into audit_event), it is numbered 030+ and is idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING or equivalent).
